components.name: Button
components.description: Native button: tinted capsule by default, filled with the link colour, or plain text. Icon-only buttons need aria-label.
components.props: type ButtonProps = PrimitiveProps<'button'> & { variant?: 'filled' | 'tinted' | 'plain' }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
Native checkbox drawn as macOS Calendar's tinted square: hollow at rest, filled
with a white tick when checked. `tint` is any CSS colour. Supply a visible
label or aria-label.
components.props: type CheckboxProps = Omit<PrimitiveProps<'input'>, 'type' | 'as'> & { tint?: string }

components.name: IconButton
components.description:
A toolbar button that is only a symbol: the plus, the chevrons, the sidebar
toggle. `plain` sits on the bar, `tinted` is a rounded square over `fill`,
`round` is the small circle a stepper uses. The label is required because the
glyph is decorative.

components.name: Segmented
components.description:
Segmented control: one of a few views or filters, the selected segment raised
on `control`. A radio group to assistive tech; `onChange` gets the option.

components.name: Select
components.description: Native select drawn like `TextField`, so a form's pop-up and its fields line up. Children are `<option>`s.
components.props: type SelectProps = Omit<PrimitiveProps<'select'>, 'as'>

components.name: Sheet
components.description: The backdrop's own fade. StyleX resolves keyframes per file, so it cannot come from styles.ts.

components.name: TextField
components.description:
Native text input over `fill`, the field in a form or a sheet. Any `type`
works, including `date`, `time` and `datetime-local`; `multiline` swaps in a
textarea. Supply a visible label or aria-label.
components.props: type TextFieldProps = Omit<PrimitiveProps<'input'>, 'as'> & { multiline?: boolean }

components.name: HStack
components.description:
A horizontal row of children, centred on the cross axis. The kit had no
horizontal primitive, so every app wrote its own flex block: reach for this
before a `stylex.create`.
components.props: type HStackProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T> & StackProps

components.name: LargeTitle
components.description: The existing 34-point large app title. It wraps naturally at cover width.
components.props: type LargeTitleProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T>

components.name: List
components.description: Semantic list. Use Row as="li" for direct children, or place Sections inside list items.
components.props: type ListProps<T extends ElementType = 'ul'> = PrimitiveProps<T>

components.name: NavigationLink
components.description: Keyboard-accessible push navigation. The destination renders inside a page with a back button.
components.props: type NavigationLinkProps = Omit<ButtonProps, 'onClick' | 'ref'> & { title: string; destination: ReactNode }

components.name: Placeholder
components.description: Centred empty, unavailable or loading content harvested from five existing apps.
components.props: type PlaceholderProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T>

components.name: Row
components.description:
Grouped row with an optional leading icon, a secondary line under the label
and trailing detail. Use `as="button"` for an action, `as="li"` inside a
`List`.

components.name: Screen
components.description: Scrolling app content. Exposes display metadata without opening a bridge or starting effects.
components.props: type ScreenProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T>

components.name: Section
components.description: Inset rounded group of rows, retaining the original grouped-list geometry.
components.props: type SectionProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T>

components.name: Sym
components.description:
An SF Symbol, tinted by the element's colour through a mask. Decorative by
default: name the enclosing button when the symbol is its only content.
components.props: type SymProps = { name: keyof typeof SYM; size?: number }

components.name: Text
components.description: A step of the type ramp. `body` emits nothing, so it inherits.
components.props:
type TextProps<T extends ElementType = 'span'> = PrimitiveProps<T> & {
  size?: Ramp | 'caption'
  weight?: 'regular' | 'medium' | 'semibold' | 'bold'
  color?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'accent'
  value?: number
  format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions
  suffix?: string
}

components.name: Title
components.description: Fixed app header, or its compact trailing accessories. Use as="h1" for a semantic heading.
components.props: type TitleProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T> & { variant?: 'header' | 'accessory' }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Native checkbox styled as the existing iOS switch. Supply a visible label or aria-label.
components.props: type ToggleProps = Omit<PrimitiveProps<'input'>, 'type' | 'as'>

components.name: VStack
components.description: A shrinking vertical stack that fills its flex parent, including the cover display.
components.props: type VStackProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T> & StackProps

components.name: Widget
components.description: Host-rendered declarative snapshot. Refresh remains the app owner's responsibility.

components.name: WidgetLabel
components.description: Passive text label using existing widget typography; never fetches or schedules refreshes.
components.props: type WidgetLabelProps<T extends ElementType = 'b'> = PrimitiveProps<T>
